title: The Last Scholarship
author: Felix Thornbury
blurb: Isandro Brightwater, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before prom.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
